model: Volatility-scaled Ridge with bounded past bias correction, conservative selection and sequential refits

oos.neutral_policy: Predictions within 0.0001% of zero are abstentions and do not count as directional hits

holdout.neutral_policy: Predictions within 0.0001% of zero are abstentions and do not count as directional hits

integrity.overlap_policy: Origins are globally spaced by the horizon; training/calibration boundaries purge immature labels
integrity.holdout: Rolling final evaluation with refits; only previously matured labels enter later training. This is not an untouched holdout.
integrity.data_note: Latest Yahoo continuous history, not point-in-time vintages. Missing target windows and roll dependencies excluded. This revised recipe requires prospective confirmation; historical results are research evidence.
integrity.normalization: ATR at each origin scales returns and interval residuals; no target-period volatility is used
integrity.calibration: Non-overlapping completed labels; monthly initial window 1260 bars, extended using sample counts only
integrity.selection: Three disjoint past calibration blocks: learn bounded median residual bias; select only if >=5% lower MAE than no change; independent final block calibrates intervals and probabilities.
integrity.macro_timing: Fixed technical recipe; current macro observations are context only, never inserted into historical training.
integrity.intervals: Outward finite-sample residual order statistics; empirical coverage is measured, not guaranteed under market drift.
